paite: Huai laitak in kumpipa Herod in Jesu tanchin ana za hi.
heading: Baptispa Johan Sihna / (Mar 6.14-29; Luk 9.7-9)
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

paite: Asikhate kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Baptispa Johan ahi; misi lak a kipan thounawn ahi; huaiziak in huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

paite: Herod in a-unau Philip zi, Herodias ziak in Johan aman a, ahen a, suangkul ah ana khum hi.
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

paite: Johan in akiang ah amah na neih asiang kei, achih ziak in.
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

paite: Johan hihlup ut mahleh mipi akihta a, zawlnei hi a apom ziak un.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

paite: Himahleh Herod pian ni ahong tun in alai ah Herodias tanu alam a, Herod akipaksak hi.
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

paite: Huai phet in anget peuhmah pe ding in thu akichiam hi.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

paite: Ama'n anu' thuhilh bang in, "Hiai kuang ah Baptispa Johan lutang hon pia in," achi hi.
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

paite: Kumpipa alungkhamta a, himahleh athuchiamte leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in piak ding thu apia hi.
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

paite: Huchi in mi asawl a, Johan lutang atansak hi.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

paite: Huan kuang in alutang ahon la ua, numei naupang kiang ah apia ua, ama'n anu kiang ah apaipihta hi.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

paite: Johan nungzuite'n aluang hong la ua, avui ua, huchi in Jesu ava hilh uhi.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n huai thu azak in, hiai a kipan long in gamkeu lam ah apaituamta hi. Himahleh mipi'n azaktak un khua a kipan khe a pai in azuita uhi.
heading: Mipi Sangnga Vakna / (Mar 6.30-44; Luk 9.10-17; Joh 6.1-14)
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

paite: Huchi in amah ahong paikhiakleh mipi tampitak amu a, ahehpih mahmah a, adamloute uh ahihdamsak hi.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

paite: Nitaklam ahong hih in, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Hiai mun gamkeu ahi a, ni akaita a, mipite khuate apai a, amau a ding nek ding aleitheihna ding un paisakta in," achi uhi.
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Apaimang uh akiphamoh kei, noumau nek ding pia un," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hiai ah tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih kia i nei uh," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

paite: Ama'n, "Huaite ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi.
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

paite: Huchi in loupa tung a tu ding in mipite thu apia a, tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nihte ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah tanghoute apia a, mipite kiang ah nungzuite'n apesawn uhi.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

paite: Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval uh bawmpi sawm-le-nih dim angah uhi.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

paite: Anete numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangnga vel ahi uh.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

paite: Huan mipite asawlmang khit in apai ma a gal khat na pai masa ding in nungzuite long ah atuangsak teitei hi.
heading: Tui Tung Ah Khe In Jesu Apai / (Mar 6.45-52; Joh 6.15-21)
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

paite: Mipite apaimang nung un thum ding in tang ah atuam in apaitou a, nitaklam ahong hih in huai ah amah kia in a-omta hi.
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

paite: Tuipi laitak ah long a-omta a; huih in ahilou lam a asawn ziak in tuikihot in asepta hi.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

paite: Zanven lina ah tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, akiang lam uh hon zuan in amu uhi.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

paite: Nungzuite'n amah tuipi tung a khe apai amuh un, "Sikha ahi," chi in abuai ua, lau in akikouta uhi.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n amaute ahoupih pah a, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

paite: Peter in adawng a, "Toupa, nang na hihleh tui tung ah nang kiang a hong pai thu hon pia in," achi hi.
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Hong pai ve,” achi a, long a kipan Peter akum a, Jesu kiang zuan in tui tung ah khe in apaita hi.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

paite: Himahleh huih nung amuh in alau a, tum ding in akisa a, "Toupa, hon hondam in," chi in akikou hi.
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

paite: Jesu'n asawk pah a, amah alen a, akiang ah, "Nang gintawm, bangziak a ginglah na hia?" achi hi.
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

paite: Huan long a atuan uleh huih adaita hi.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

paite: Long a omte'n, "Pathian Tapa na hi taktak hi," chi in amah abia uhi.
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

paite: Huan gal khat lam akai uleh, Gennesaret gam ahong tung uhi.
heading: Gennesaret A Damlou Hihdamna / (Mar 6.53-56)
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

paite: Huai mun a mite'n amah atheihtak un, huai kim gam tengteng ah mi asawl ua, damlou tengteng akiang ah ahon pi ua;
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

paite: Apuan mong bek khoih theih angen ngutngut ua; huan akhoih peuhmah adam zel uhi.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
